run_function_few_shot_qa: run the few_shot_qa sgl function with a question to get a single model answer
run_function_stream_answer: stream the answer output from few_shot_qa function using state.text_iter
run_function_batch_questions: run the few_shot_qa function with a batch of questions and return all answers
create_runtime_backend: create an sgl.Runtime backend with a model path for the default llm backend
test_few_shot_qa_single: test the few_shot_qa function runs and returns a correct answer for a single question
